Colress Machine (Japanese: VSキュレムII VS Kyurem II), titled VS Kyurem II in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 537th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 13th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Kyurem II (Japanese: アクロマ・マシーン Machine) in the VIZ Media translation and Colress Machine in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

Colress Machine (Japanese: VSキュレムII VS Kyurem II), titled VS Kyurem II in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 537th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 13th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Kyurem II (Japanese: アクロマ・マシーン Machine) in the VIZ Media translation and Colress Machine in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Zinzolin continues his battle against Colress.
exits the Relic Passage and arrives next to the Pokémon World Tournament construction site.
Blake is revealed to have captured a named Kabutott and a named Glisott.
Blake finds Zinzolin defeated by and , who proceed to transform into their Therian Formes.
Colress reveals he is in possession of the Reveal Glass.
tells everything about the black-suited s, the Colress Machine, and the microchip in her pendant.
Whitley decides to find her missing pendant so that she may give it to Rood or Gorm.
